interval_years.quote: All licenses may be renewed biennially.

available.quote: The board may grant a license or certificate to an applicant holding a license or certificate in good standing in another state whose requirements for licensure and certification are equal to or greater than those required by this chapter if the board has authorized an exam waiver agreement with the State.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license or certificate in good standing in another state with requirements equal to or greater than South Carolina's; exam waiver agreement must be authorized by the board. Applicant may also exempt the technical exam by verifying passage of an essentially equivalent exam in another state, even without a reciprocal agreement. Must pass the SC Commercial Contractors Business, Law and Project Management exam and comply with all other licensing and certification requirements.

definition_quote.value: "General construction" means the installation, replacement, or repair of a building, structure, highway, sewer, grading, asphalt or concrete paving, or improvement of any kind to real property. "Mechanical construction" means the installation, replacement, or repair of plumbing, heating, air conditioning, process piping, refrigeration, lightning protection equipment, or electrical components, fixtures, or devices of any kind, excluding burglar alarm work.
definition_quote.quote: "General construction" means the installation, replacement, or repair of a building, structure, highway, sewer, grading, asphalt or concrete paving, or improvement of any kind to real property.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: An entity which does not have a valid license as required by this chapter may not bring an action either at law or in equity to enforce the provisions of a contract.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
